text_markup: The Corp plays {card:Cultivate}, acting on the top 5 cards of R&D by trashing 1 card, adding 1 card to HQ, and arranging the rest in any order. They do not tell the Runner what location in R&D the trashed card came from, nor what location the card added to HQ came from.
